traps.resolution_rule: 03_bond_credit_docs/credit_agreement.docx Schedule 1.01(c) states the classification criterion and Sec1 Definitions clause (i)'s own proviso text caps only revenue enhancements as so classified; cost savings are added back uncapped regardless of the QofE's own supplemental working schedule
